about: The first Ministry duty (docs/story/DUTIES.md, Game/GameQuarry.cs): the warden's induction ends at the Ministry Quarry's mine wall (Karl, 2026-11-11), and this duty follows on there with the works: someone already at the quarry starts at the second step, anyone else is sent by crew bus, where the machines are taught on the job (Karl, 2026-11-10: the induction is about the person; machines come in stages, working for the Ministry). Each step's cue is judged on the host. Cues: reach (stand within amount m of the spot), ride (board the crew bus at the spot's stop and ride it to the other: spot colony or quarry), power (lay a power cable at the quarry's machines), feed (tip what you carry into the quarry's Materials Bin), recipe (set the quarry Assembler's recipe), bunk (lie in a Bunk), wait (seconds). Spots: stop (the colony's bus stop), quarry (the quarry's bus stop), genset, bin, assembler (the quarry's). Text is ASCII; {Action} is the player's own key. The bus is a STAND-IN (Source/StandIns) until the vehicle redo.
speaker: Foreman Grubb
memo: Inmate {name}: you are assigned to the Ministry Quarry. Report to the bus stop outside the colony gate. The crew bus will collect you.

report.title: Report to the bus stop
report.text: Your first Ministry duty: the quarry. Go to the bus stop outside the colony gate (the orange marker) and wait for the crew bus.

steps.title: The crew bus
steps.text: Board the crew bus once it has stopped.
steps.say: Bus is coming, inmate. Stand still and try to look employable.

steps.title: Power the works
steps.text: Linking tool ({Streak2}): {Fire} on the genset's power port, then {Fire} on the Assembler's.
steps.say: Now the works. First job: they're dead. Run a cable from the genset to the Assembler.
steps.hint: Aim the linking tool at the genset (the orange marker) until it names its power port, press {Fire}, then do the same on the Assembler. {Aim} takes the last node off.

steps.title: Your quota
steps.text: Dig with the ground drill (hold {Fire}), then {Interact} on the Materials Bin.
steps.say: Quota time. Dig, then tip it in the bin. The bin feeds the Assembler, the Assembler feeds the Ministry.
steps.hint: Ground drill out, hold {Fire} on the ground for a few seconds, then {Interact} on the Materials Bin (the orange marker).

steps.title: The Assembler
steps.text: Configure tool: {Fire} on the Assembler and pick a recipe.
steps.say: Pick something to make. Most of it wants steel, and steel is the smelter's job. That's another duty, another day.
steps.hint: Configure tool out, aim at the Assembler (the orange marker) and press {Fire}, then pick any recipe.

steps.title: Back to the colony
steps.text: Board the crew bus at the quarry's stop.
steps.say: Not bad, for a convict. Bus back is at the stop. Don't miss it: the next one is in a fortnight.

steps.title: Lights out
steps.text: Look at a Bunk and press {Interact}. You wake here if you die.
steps.say: Shift's over. Find a bunk, inmate. You'll want the sleep.
steps.hint: The Bunks are in the colony yard (the orange marker). {Interact} again gets you up.

steps.title: Duty done
steps.text: First shift done. The Ministry will call you for the next one.
steps.say: Noted on your file. Favourably, which is rare. Don't let it go to your head.
